tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background. A neutral with a slight cherry bias, never pure grey.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and selected controls sitting on surface-100.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Recessed fills: segmented control track, notices, neutral badges.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on any surface. Also the selected day in the week strip.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Bar names above titles, meta lines, section subtitles. Passes 4.5:1 on surface-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers inside sheets and fact lists. Never a card border on surface-100.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Uptown Cherry. The wordmark accent, Live pills, the location pin and primary actions. Use sparingly: one cherry moment per screen region.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind brand text: type badges (Clock, Cover), rented-out notices.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and dots on a brand fill.

tokens.name: signal-good
tokens.usage: Seen recently. Only for the confirmed status line, never decoration.

tokens.name: signal-warn
tokens.usage: Price TBA and other gaps in the data.

tokens.name: line-brick
tokens.usage: Brick Street's line color, brick orange. Bar bullets and route segments only.

tokens.name: line-corner
tokens.usage: Corner Bar's line color, a nod to the brown in its Instagram mark.

tokens.name: line-skippers
tokens.usage: Skippers Pub's line color, a nod to the navy in its logo.

tokens.name: line-chanks
tokens.usage: Chanks' line color, a nod to its red wall and lettering.

tokens.name: line-rudys
tokens.usage: Lil Rudys' line color, a nod to its maroon badge.

tokens.name: line-side
tokens.usage: Side Bar / The Woods' line color, a woods green.

tokens.name: line-1868
tokens.usage: Bar 1868's line color, a vintage slate for the oldest name on the list.

tokens.name: line-opub
tokens.usage: O'Pub's line color, a nod to the pub green in its logo.

tokens.name: line-calendula
tokens.usage: Calendula's line color, a marigold gold from its sunburst.

tokens.name: line-allarrys
tokens.usage: Al & Larry's line color. No brand color to nod to yet.

tokens.name: on-line
tokens.usage: Bullet initials on every line color. Each line color passes 4.5:1 against it.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The wordmark and splash moments only.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: The price line. Always tabular numerals.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Time windows, status lines, bar names.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels: weekday names, sheet section labels.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a meta item and its icon.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between badges; between cards in a sheet.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between deal cards; notice padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding and the page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space between time-of-day sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Bar bullets and small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Day buttons, notices, segmented controls.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Deal cards and list cards.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of the bottom sheet.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Live pills, status badges, buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Every tappable card on surface-100. Cards inside a sheet drop it.
